title: Date picker
description: A date field with a Calendar popover (YYYY-MM-DD, min / max). Never type="date".
when: Schedule a job, filter by day, set a due date.
a11y: The button's name includes the chosen date; the popover is a dialog with the Calendar grid (arrows, PageUp / PageDown, Enter); Escape closes and returns focus to the button.

instead.need: Pick on the page, or a range
